fields.description: 6-byte ASCII tag written by the default-save path; reads 'sudoku' in the rev8-logical domain.
fields.evidence: FUN_080156e0 default init copies ROM defaults (*_DAT_080157f0, 4 bytes to buf+4 and 2 bytes to buf+8); rev8-logical bytes [4,10) of baseline.sav are 73 75 64 6f 6b 75 ('sudoku').
fields.name: header_magic

fields.description: Trailing header byte written by the same ROM-default init as the magic; 0x00 in the fresh baseline save and covered by config_block_checksum, so it persists as save state.
fields.evidence: FUN_080156e0 writes *(u8*)(buf+10) from ROM defaults alongside the magic; FUN_0800656c/FUN_080065dc include offset 10 in the checksummed range [4,360).
fields.name: header_tag

fields.description: Leading flag byte of the config-block payload; mutable option/state bits candidate, covered by config_block_checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800656c writes and FUN_080065dc verifies EEPROM block 0 ([0,360)) as 45-DMA-chunk transfer via FUN_08019940/FUN_080196c4; byte at offset 11 is the first payload byte after the 7-byte header and is zeroed by the FUN_080156e0 default path (func_0x080173b0 memset 0x168).
fields.name: config_flags

fields.description: First aligned 32-bit word of the config-block payload (difficulty / progress-counter candidate); mutable and checksum-covered.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800656c computes the block-0 checksum over bytes [4,360) and FUN_080065dc compares it against the u32 at offset 0; word at offset 12 is inside that range and zero in the fresh baseline save.
fields.name: progress_value0

fields.description: Remainder of the 360-byte config block: per-mode progress and settings area, all zero in the fresh save.
fields.evidence: FUN_080065dc loads EEPROM [0,360) in one call (size 0x168) and FUN_0800656c stores it back; FUN_080156e0 zeroes the whole 0x168-byte buffer on the default path; baseline bytes [16,360) are all zero and sum with the header to the stored checksum 667.
fields.name: config_reserved

fields.description: 884-byte puzzle/progress payload of the second EEPROM block: per-puzzle grids and completion state (20-entry select screen, 10x5 flag loops). All zero in the fresh save.
fields.evidence: FUN_080065dc loads EEPROM [360,1248) in one call (size 0x378, eeprom base 0x168) and FUN_0800656c stores it back via FUN_08019940; FUN_08010d60 renders a 20-entry puzzle select (*param_1 < 0x14) with 10x5 completion-flag lookups through the FUN_08011418 bit-test routine; baseline bytes [364,1248) are all zero, matching the stored checksum 0.
fields.name: puzzle_cells

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'sudoku' header tag at logical offset 4
